ruleSummaries.description: The value of the Length key specified in the stream dictionary shall match the number of bytes in the file following the LINE FEED (0Ah) character after the stream keyword and preceding the EOL marker before the endstream keyword

checks.errorMessage: Actual length of the stream (38 byte(s)) does not match the value of the Length key in the Stream dictionary (39 byte(s))

ruleSummaries.description: DeviceGray shall only be used if a device independent DefaultGray colour space has been set when the DeviceGray colour space is used, or if a PDF/A OutputIntent is in effect

checks.errorMessage: DeviceGray colour space is used without output intent profile

ruleSummaries.description: File identifiers shall be defined by the ID entry in a PDF file’s trailer dictionary

checks.errorMessage: Missing or empty ID in the document trailer

ruleSummaries.description: The document catalog dictionary of a conforming file shall contain the Metadata key whose value is a metadata stream as defined in ISO 32000-2:2020, 14.3.2. The metadata stream dictionary shall contain entry Type with value /Metadata and entry Subtype with value /XML

checks.errorMessage: The document catalog dictionary doesn't contain metadata key or metadata stream dictionary does not contain either entry Type with value /Metadata or entry Subtype with value /XML

ruleSummaries.description: The file header shall begin at byte zero and shall consist of "%PDF-2.n" followed by a single EOL marker, where 'n' is a single digit number between 0 (30h) and 9 (39h)

checks.errorMessage: File header %PDF-1.4 (offset = 0) starts at non-zero offset or does not match the pattern %PDF-2.n, where 'n' is a single digit number between 0 and 9

ruleSummaries.description: The font programs for all fonts used for rendering within a conforming file shall be embedded within that file, as defined in ISO 32000-2:2020, 9.9

checks.errorMessage: The font program is not embedded

validationResult.statement: PDF file is not compliant with Validation Profile requirements.
